result.reason: The redline adds the required professional/workmanlike, software-conformance, legal-compliance, malicious-code, and remedy concepts, and preserves the unrelated disclaimer through a carveout. However, it does not limit the services warranty to the preferred 90-day period (or fallback 30-day period), effectively creating an indefinite services warranty, and it does not clearly cover non-software deliverables. The reference to “Article VIX” also appears erroneous and should be corrected. Thus, it does not precisely reach the playbook position or change no more than necessary.
